literal.prompt: Как называется материк вокруг Южного полюса?

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: PASS factual: NOAA PMEL Arctic FAQ L214 explicitly places the South Pole in the middle of Antarctica, a continent surrounded by ocean. None of Eurasia, North America or Australia contains the geographical South Pole. Russian материк follows physical landmass usage; this does not require selecting between a six-landmass convention and seven cultural continents.

sourcesLocators.locator: NOAA PMEL FAQ L214, question 11: explicit South Pole in Antarctica

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.finalIndependentReassessment: FINAL own reassessment: NOAA L214 explicitly places South Pole in Antarctica. Four choices remain distinct physical continents; only Antarctica satisfies whole geographic relation. Source now directly binds this fact.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Это Антарктида. Почти вся её поверхность покрыта мощным ледниковым щитом.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: PASS: AAP Antarctic geography L299-L303 says almost completely ice-sheet-covered, more than 4 km thick at maximum, snow accumulation/compression and highest exposed peaks. The explanation correctly uses почти вся, not 100 percent, and ледниковый щит rather than ocean sea ice.

sourcesLocators.locator: AAP full geography article L299-L307, especially L299-L303

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.finalIndependentReassessment: FINAL own reassessment: AAP L299 states almost completely ice-sheet covered and more than 4 km maximum thickness; L302-L303 distinguish underlying land, accumulation and exposed peaks. Current почти вся and мощным are supported without 100-percent overclaim.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Антарктида — покрытый льдом материк вокруг Южного полюса.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: PASS: NOAA PMEL L214 supports continent/location, and AAP L299-L303 supports extensive land-ice cover. Покрытый льдом is a normal general description, not an assertion that every point is ice-covered. Ice cover is an independent useful extra beyond the queried South-Pole/continent identity.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.finalIndependentReassessment: FINAL own reassessment: NOAA L214 supplies continent/pole relation and AAP L299-L303 independently supplies ice cover. Added ice-cover fact remains useful beyond asked MAIN, and generic покрытый does not require every rock outcrop covered.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Евразия — крупнейший материк, объединяющий Европу и Азию.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: PASS with explicit inference: NG L6 ranks Asia largest, followed by Africa, North America, South America, Antarctica, Europe and Australia; L44/L133 repeat Asia largest. L46-L47 explicitly join Europe and Asia into physical Eurasia and explain cultural separation. In Russian six-материк usage combining the already-largest Asia with Europe necessarily leaves Eurasia larger than each other separately named материк. This ranking follows the supplied ranked comparison plus union, not the adjective enormous alone. It is not a claim that NG calls Eurasia one of its seven cultural continents.

sourcesLocators.locator: NG original article L6,L44-L47,L108,L121,L133-L137: seven-region ranking and physical Eurasia union

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.finalIndependentReassessment: FINAL own reassessment: NG L6 gives full largest-to-smallest seven-part ranking, L44/L133 identify Asia largest and L46-L47 join Europe/Asia into Eurasia. Physical-six-mainland ranking is an explicit logical inference from ranked Asia plus Europe union, not enormous adjective or a claim NG uses six cultural continents.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Северная Америка — материк, северные берега которого выходят к Арктике.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: PASS: NOAA PMEL L142 states Arctic Ocean surrounded by Alaska, Canada, Greenland and Russia; L180-L181/L247 situate Alaskan and Canadian Arctic coastal populations/regions. NG L42 and L78-L90 place Greenland, Canada and Alaska in North America and explicitly describe its freezing Arctic north. Together they ground the continent’s northern Arctic shores, not a mistaken country/continent identity.

sourcesLocators.locator: L42,L78-L90: North America/Greenland/Arctic extent

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.finalIndependentReassessment: FINAL own reassessment: NOAA L142 puts Alaska/Canada around Arctic Ocean, L180-L181/L247 confirms their Arctic coasts/regions; NG L42,L78-L90 puts Alaska/Canada/Greenland in North America. Continent northern Arctic-shore statement is grounded, no false country/continent equivalence.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Австралия — самый малый по площади материк.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: PASS: Geoscience Australia L14 explicitly calls Australia the smallest continental land mass, separately from its sixth-largest-country ranking. NG L6 and L145 independently rank Australia the smallest continent. The Russian note correctly ranks материк area, not sovereign-country area.

sourcesLocators.locator: Full 18-line Geoscience page, L14: smallest continental land mass

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.finalIndependentReassessment: FINAL own reassessment: Geoscience full L14 explicitly says smallest continental land mass, not sixth-largest-country rank; NG L6/L145 supports smallest continent. Current note correctly says smallest mainland by area.
